findings.note: Miller's season averages are 25.6 points, 6.2 rebounds and 1.8 assists in 33.8 minutes, which adds up to about 33.6 PRA, above the 30.5 line. He is carrying a bigger load while Coby White (calf) and Kon Knueppel (hamstring) are out. No game-day injury report was found.
Against these same Nets on Oct. 21, Miller had 18 points, 3 rebounds and 1 assist (22 PRA) on 7-of-21 shooting in 36 minutes. His shot volume was still very high.

RotoWire says his results swing a lot: he has scored under 20 points three times and over 30 three times. His logged PRA totals are 22, 8, 45, 46, 46, 28 and 34, so he went over 30.5 in 4 of 7 games, and his shooting efficiency has been poor.
